content.rendered:
The CP-200 is our most requested pump for cooling towers and process water. A back pull-out design lets your crew replace the seal without touching the pipework.

Typical applications

  • Cooling water circuits
  • Irrigation and transfer
  • Fire-water boost

Supplied with a mechanical seal, coupling guard and baseplate. Bronze or stainless impellers on request.

excerpt.rendered: End-suction pump for clean water and cooling circuits, up to 200 m³/h.

acf.specs:
Flow rate: 200 m³/h
Head: 45 m
Motor: 37 kW, 400 V
Max temperature: 90 °C
Casing: cast iron
